criteria.reason: The workout overflow menu includes a “Skip Exercise” option.
Selecting it opens a confirmation modal before applying the skip.
The skip handler sends every set in the current exercise with status "skipped".
When all current-week sets are skipped, the card displays “Skipped” instead of a partial completion label.
A skipped exercise can be resumed during the workout, which clears the skipped sets.
The existing sets endpoint accepts and persists skipped status.
A server test covers persisting skipped status and removing skipped sets on resume.
No new client test for the skip UI appears in the diff.
The harness reports all server and client tests passing.
The added UI copy is direct and contains no exclamation marks.
